title: Wool Armor
description: Allows you to make basic armor out of wool!
body:
Allows you to craft very basic armor out of wool!

- Use a standard crafting table, no floor crafting or custom crafters needed
- Use standard armor craft patterns
- Armor is half as effective as leather armor, and can't be repaired to maintain balance!
- Armor will be dyed the same color as the wool used to craft it

Must use the same color wool for every block of the armor!
